set -eu
old=/var/lib/stalwart
next=/var/lib/stalwart-v2
template=/etc/private-mail-datastore/config.json
route=/store-selection/config.json
fence="$old/.private-mail-v1-fenced"
receipt="$next/.private-mail-v2-copy-complete"
refuse() { echo "Email storage route refused: $1." >&2; exit 1; }
exists() { [ -e "$1" ] || [ -L "$1" ]; }
valid_receipt() {
  [ -f "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] && [ "$(wc -l <"$1")" -eq 1 ] &&
    grep -Exq 'private-mail-longhorn-v2 [0-9a-f]{64}' "$1"
}
selected="$old"
if exists "$receipt"; then
  valid_receipt "$receipt" || refuse "unverified V2 completion receipt"
  [ -d "$next/data" ] && [ ! -L "$next/data" ] || refuse "the V2 store is missing"
  if exists "$fence"; then
    valid_receipt "$fence" && cmp -s "$fence" "$receipt" || refuse "the V1 fence and V2 receipt disagree"
  else
    if exists "$fence.tmp"; then
      valid_receipt "$fence.tmp" && cmp -s "$fence.tmp" "$receipt" || refuse "incomplete V1 fence"
    else
      (set -C; cat "$receipt" >"$fence.tmp")
    fi
    sync
    mv -- "$fence.tmp" "$fence"
    sync
  fi
  selected="$next"
elif exists "$fence" || exists "$fence.tmp"; then
  refuse "V1 was fenced and its V2 completion receipt is missing"
fi
[ -d "$selected/data" ] && [ ! -L "$selected/data" ] || refuse "the selected store is missing"
[ "$(grep -Fc "\"$old/data\"" "$template")" -eq 1 ] || refuse "the datastore configuration path is unverified"
tmp=$(mktemp /store-selection/.config.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp"' EXIT
sed "s#\"$old/data\"#\"$selected/data\"#" "$template" >"$tmp"
[ "$(grep -Fc "\"$selected/data\"" "$tmp")" -eq 1 ] || refuse "the selected datastore configuration is unverified"
mv -- "$tmp" "$route"
if [ "$selected" = "$next" ]; then
  echo "Email storage route selected Longhorn V2."
else
  echo "Email storage route selected the original encrypted store."
fi
